cells.gaps: No station outside Gombe is shown recording cases digitally, and no count of stations using the Criminal Database Systems is given. How the record is made is not stated inside three years: the paper statements of 2021 and 2022 are older. Governance and a station total have not been found.
cells.note: Gombe State received the first digital police station in June 2026, with case files managed digitally, and the Inspector-General opened nationwide training on the new Criminal Database Systems in September 2025. Both are preparation or pilot; rung 3 needs a system live in stations beyond its pilot.
